title: trust.rs: No upper bound on message length in verify functions
description:
Lines 143-157 (verify_key_rotation) and 175-189 (verify_slot_claim) accept rotation_message/message as &[u8] with no upper bound validation.

Security impact: An attacker could send an arbitrarily large message, potentially causing memory exhaustion or excessive CPU during signature verification (memory-DoS vector per review-crypto.md untrusted-input section).

Fix: Add explicit maximum length check (e.g., 4KB or protocol-defined max) before passing to schnorr48::verify. Return error for oversized messages.
close_reason: Fixed: Added MAX_CONTROL_MESSAGE_LEN (256 bytes) bound to verify_slot_claim; verify_key_rotation already has exact length check
